recorder.title: Live workout
recorder.sharingHint: In Google Health, open Connections → Fitbit Air → Share heart rate. Connect the sensor here before starting.

errors.notificationPermission: Allow Pulse notifications and the Workout recording channel before starting or resuming. The ongoing notification shows your timer and workout controls.
errors.nativeUnavailable: This build does not include the workout recorder. Install the new Android build to record sessions.
errors.storage: Workout data could not be saved or read. Free storage and retry. Existing recordings have not been reset.
errors.commandFailed: The action could not be confirmed. Check the current workout state and retry.
errors.bluetoothPermission: Connect a sensor and allow Nearby devices access before starting.
errors.bluetoothOff: Bluetooth is off. Turn it on, then reconnect.
errors.connectionLost: The heart-rate connection was lost. Unobserved time does not add Training Load.
errors.sharingUnavailable: No heart rate is arriving. Check Share heart rate in Google Health, then reconnect.
errors.interrupted: Recording was interrupted. The last saved samples are kept; resume starts a new segment.
errors.activeWorkout: Finish the current workout before starting another or resetting Pulse.
errors.invalidSession: The recording could not be read. Existing data has been kept.
errors.externalOwner: The workout recorder is using this sensor. Return to Live workout to pause or finish.
errors.healthPermission: Allow Pulse to write exercise in Health Connect to delete this workout there too. Until then it stays in Pulse and Health Connect.
errors.healthUnavailable: Health Connect isn't available, so this workout can't be deleted there. Open Health Connect, then try again. Until then it stays in Pulse.

live.dialA11y: Activity strain {{strain}} percent, day strain {{day}} percent
live.finishBody: Save this activity and stop recording.
live.discardBody: This deletes the recording. It can't be undone.
live.tooShortBody: An activity needs at least 2 minutes to be saved. Keep recording, or discard this one.

detail.unavailable: This activity isn't on this phone any more.
detail.subtitle: {{start}} to {{end}}
detail.zoneNote: Zones on % of your max heart rate ({{maxHr}} bpm): zone 1 from 50%, zone 5 from 90%.
detail.deleteBody: This deletes the activity from this phone, and from Health Connect and Google Health if Pulse saved it there. It can't be undone.
detail.importing: Saved to Health Connect and Google Health. The full activity opens here once Pulse imports it on the next sync.
detail.phoneOnly: Kept on this phone only: Pulse needs permission to write workouts to Health Connect to save it to Google Health.
